name: dif.sh
tagline: Markdown feature flags your coding agent installs for you
description: Open source feature flags. Every flag is a markdown file that lives with the code it controls: what it does, why it exists, and what you decided, reviewed in a PR like any other change. Your coding agent installs Dif in one command, no account, and reads the context file so it knows what's live and what was already tried. A/B tests wait in the same files until you have traffic. Send events to your own analytics, or let Dif Cloud read the results and write the decision into the file.

name: Reflexio
tagline: Behavioral learning that makes AI agents better over time
description: Reflexio makes AI agents better with every interaction. When users correct an agent, a path fails, or something works particularly well, Reflexio turns that experience into behavior the agent can reuse next time. Instead of leaving valuable lessons buried in logs, your agent continuously learns what to repeat and what to avoid — with every learning visible, testable, and reversible. Reduce task failure rate by more than 30%, while saving tokens by more than 60%.

name: Ponytail
tagline: Make new code the last resort
description: Ponytail is a plugin that makes coding agents write the least code that works. Before adding anything, it checks whether the change is needed, already exists, or can use the stdlib or a native API. Same behavior, fewer lines to own.

name: Hyperprobe
tagline: Lets your AI agents debug production without redeploying
description: HyperProbe is how backend teams debug production issues they can't reproduce locally. Instead of adding a log line and waiting on a deploy, we let Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor drop read-only probes into a running service and capture the variable state that was never recorded. From there your agent debugs like it has a local repro, closing the bug in one sitting.

name: at8pm
tagline: Your honest journal
description: Every entry you write today locks at the time that you configured — 8pm by default. Once it locks, that's it: no editing, no rewriting history, no quietly polishing what you actually felt in the moment. Just an honest, raw, and unfiltered record of your day. Entries sync across your devices with your own private iCloud and never with a first/third-party server. When typing is not enough, record a squope (square video) or an audio note. at8pm is free to download (up to 2 entries per day).

name: Experiential Labs
tagline: Open source AI gateway turning traffic into a better model
description: Experiential is the open source, zero markup gateway for BYOK, self-hosted and 1000+ marketplace models. It learns from your traffic to cut costs, recommend better models, and train a specialized model you own.

name: PostBox
tagline: Stage and post designs from your mac
description: PostBox turns the MacBook notch into a drag and drop poster for the work you make. Drag an export in, write the caption once, and post to X, Bluesky, Threads, LinkedIn, Dribbble, Instagram, Threads, Pinterest Behance and Cosmos at once.

name: CommuteBar
tagline: Live commute times in your menu bar
description: Glance at traffic. Leave on time. CommuteBar puts live commute times visibly on your Mac menu bar, no app-switching required. Save multiple destinations like office, school, gym. Schedule automatic switching for recurring commutes and get leave soon / leave now indicators and optional notifications. You also get route comparison, delayed traffic alerts and different travel modes.

name: Queuebrick
tagline: The Letterboxd alternative
description: Fast, elegant movie tracking. Search a film, rate it, queue it, rank what to watch next. The Letterboxd alternative.

name: Retold
tagline: Turn family voices into hand-drawn story films
description: Record a memory or import an old voice note. Retold keeps the real voice and turns the story into a hand-drawn film and readable book. The sketches follow the people, places and little details as they are spoken, then every memory is kept together on your family shelf.

name: GitWarren
tagline: Review code with your coding agents before committing
description: It’s a local, PR-like code review app that works directly with your working tree. You can review committed, staged, unstaged, and untracked changes, leave inline comments, and organize the work into actual reviews without having to push anything anywhere. You connect whatever AI you're using through MCP and have a coherent experience without all the mundane copy-pasting. All comments live in threads attached to specific code changes, so it’s easy to follow what’s going on over time.

name: BrickForgerAI
tagline: Turn any prompt into a brick set you can actually build
description: Type a prompt, get a buildable brick model. The AI (image + mesh gen) is just the front door. The real work is the brick-placing engine: voxelizing the shape, tiling it with actual LEGO-compatible parts, staggering seams for strength, running structural analysis (gravity load) to catch weak points, then refining with slopes and tiles (currently a 55 part brick library). You get a realldr file, parts list, and step-by-step PDF instructions. Renders below done with the Mecabricks Advanced add-on.

name: ​​AI Agents Listing​
tagline: ​​The agentic AI ecosystem, in one directory​
description: A directory of the agentic AI stack: AI agents that do real work, MCP servers that connect them to your tools and data, and agent skills that extend what they can do. Every listing gets an indexable page, and pages link across the three layers, so an agent shows the MCP servers it works with and the skills that extend it. Search, categories, comparisons and alternatives run across all of it. Listing is free.

name: LiftmyCV 3.0
tagline: Your personal AI job search & auto-apply agent.
description: Meet the brand-new LiftmyCV 3.0, an all-in-one AI job search platform that matches you with relevant jobs, generates job-specific resumes and cover letters, and applies on your behalf. This version introduces a new user interface, a Job Hub with 1.6M+ job openings, and 5 auto-apply modes, including First and Stealth Apply, which automatically scan jobs posted within the past 24 hours, match them to your profile, and apply autonomously – no Chrome extension required.

name: Malyatko — Baby tracker
tagline: Privacy-first baby tracker that works fully offline
description: Malyatko is a privacy-first baby tracker for the first years. Unlike most trackers it needs no account, shows no ads, and works fully offline — your baby's data stays on your device and iCloud, not a server. Track 18 activity types (sleep, feeding, diapers, weight, temperature, meds) with charts, development milestones, AI insights that turn your logs into simple tips, and sleep predictions. Apple Watch, widgets, and iCloud family sharing. Free, with optional premium.

name: Brain Rest
tagline: Don’t let your browser rot your brain
description: Brain Rest turns browser screen time into a character you’ll actually want to protect. See every site and tab in one dashboard, watch your Brain Level shift from Fresh to Dead, and use an on-page widget to stay aware without breaking your flow. When awareness isn’t enough, set daily website limits, block distracting sites, start Focus Mode or Pomodoro, and take guided breaks. Available for Chrome and Edge with a free plan and optional Pro features.

name: Muse Spark 1.3
tagline: Meta’s flagship for coding and long-horizon agents
description: Muse Spark 1.3 is Meta’s latest flagship for agentic work and coding. Same $1.25 / $4.25 API price as 1.2, with about 20% fewer tool calls and 25% fewer tokens on coding in Meta’s own comparisons. It leads DeepSWE v1.1 at 75.4 and ties Terminal-Bench 2.1 at 88.8. Live today in Muse Code and the Meta Model API. Max reasoning follows after safety testing.

name: Autnest: Drive & AI
tagline: Automotive hub for drivers & garages — with AI built in
description: Autnest brings car life into one place — digital garage, live map, marketplace, community, and roadside help. Drive.AI helps with research, diagnostic-style guidance, and damage workflows as decision support — not a substitute for professional inspection. For garages and businesses: workspace tools for listings, inventory, and customer ops. Built for real roads. Web + iOS + Android. Free to start.

name: supatools
tagline: The directory for product makers
description: Discover the best web development tools, libraries, and resources to help you build your next project.

name: VerbX Localize
tagline: Install Once Localize Forever
description: VerbX Localize helps developers ship multilingual apps without maintaining translation keys or endless locale files. Wrap your source text, choose the languages, and Localize handles translation with context, glossary support, translation memory, review workflows, and continuous sync through SDKs, CLI, and GitHub. You pay for new meaning once; cached and reused translations stay free.
